text: The analysis found a perfect match to the Sotos syndrome signature, with an area-under-the-curve of 1.0 based on all 500 submitted probes, which are also present on the 450K platform. All of the probes overlap with the known Sotos syndrome signature, but the direction of effect is reversed compared with the original cohort. The result is limited to the study it was derived from and does not imply applicability to other studies. The next-best match was Claes-Jensen syndrome with a Z-score of 31.4. No data were missing or refused.
